description: This file defines a mock class OcdmSessionMock for testing purposes, which implements the IOcdmSession interface related to DRM session management in the Rialto server component. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for various DRM session operations.

classes.name: OcdmSessionMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IOcdmSession interface for testing DRM session behaviors in Rialto server.

methods.name: constructSession
methods.description: Mocks the construction of a DRM session with specified session type and initialization data.

methods.name: getChallengeData
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of challenge data for DRM license acquisition.

methods.name: storeLicenseData
methods.description: Mocks storing license data received from license server.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Mocks updating the DRM session with a response.

methods.name: decryptBuffer
methods.description: Mocks decryption of an encrypted buffer.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Mocks decryption with additional parameters, marked for removal in future.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Mocks removal of a DRM session.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Mocks closing of a DRM session.

methods.name: cancelChallengeData
methods.description: Mocks cancellation of challenge data process.

methods.name: destructSession
methods.description: Mocks destruction of a DRM session.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of key status for a given key ID.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of the CDM key session ID.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Mocks selection of a key ID for the session.

methods.name: hasKeyId
methods.description: Mocks checking if a key ID exists.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of the last DRM error code.
